summary: Full re-test of CONCEPTOR after the bilingual/3-context iteration. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for the new schema (lang field, per-context timing_factors object in /api/meta, 3 contexts) — 27/27 pytest tests pass including 2 live Claude Sonnet 4.6 streaming tests. Frontend: 4 Playwright suites covering logo/headline, language switch + persistence, dynamic form per category, per-step guides, per-context timing chips, full business_deal e2e, AI Coach streaming in ID and EN, copy buttons, reset, and layout at 1920/390. No blocking defects found.

issues: Decorative absolute element (DIV.absolute -right-24 ... SPAN.font-display text-[16rem] text-white/xx) extends ~96px past the viewport right edge (right=2016 vs vw=1920). document.scrollWidth stays 1920 so there is no horizontal scrollbar and pointer-events are disabled — cosmetic only, but worth clipping with overflow-hidden on the parent.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic): add overflow-hidden to the hero section so the oversized decorative numeral does not extend past the 1920px viewport.

OPTIONAL (watch): one AI run in Bahasa Indonesia contained the substring ' the ' in the rendered output (body text was otherwise fully Indonesian). Could not reproduce on the backend pytest run. If it recurs, tighten the LANG_NAMES instruction with an explicit 'no English words at all' constraint.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.py build_numbers: with BATNA-superior inputs target is recomputed as reservation*1.05 and compromise is the midpoint, so the ladder stays strictly descending — verified across 9 context/alt-value combinations. No change needed.
server.py /api/ai/generate has no server-side timeout guard; a hung upstream stream would keep the SSE connection open indefinitely. Consider asyncio.wait_for around the stream loop.
engine.py score_pact/build_script correctly skip blank metric labels and blank achievement titles (verified: A=0, quantified_metrics=0, no 'Achievement — .' in script body).
server.py /api/sessions/{sid} correctly projects out _id. /api/analyze is stateless and fast (<50ms).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: a few pact_sessions documents created by the session round-trip test; localStorage seeded with a business_deal payload (conceptor_pact_input_v2) during AI testing.
test_credentials: None required — app has no auth (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is https://pact-solver-1.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend/.env), NOT the URL quoted in the review request. Non-browser requests need a User-Agent header. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope, so '-p no:xdist' breaks the run; use '-n 2'. AI tests live in TestAi (~75s for both) — deselect them for fast runs. Verified this iteration: /api/meta timing_factors is an object keyed by context with 8 factors each; cross-context timing keys score 0; EN/ID copy has no cross-language leakage in engine output; ladder monotonic for BATNA-superior and no-alternative cases; unknown context falls back to salary_raise with 200; guides differ across all 3 categories on all 6 steps; input-offer-value hidden only for salary_raise; business_deal e2e score 8 -> 69 with Rp-formatted descending ladder (69.5M/62M/51M/40M) and business-specific objections; AI script mode streams and completes in both languages with markdown rendered (no literal --- / > / ** / ##); reset clears the form; no console errors anywhere; no overflow at 390px.
